Progress is saved automatically in this browser. To move it, copy your save code and paste it on the other device. Save codes can be reused by anyone who has a copy; this offline page cannot limit a code to one device. Importing merges progress and may increase displayed scores.

Integrity rules

The main things you can't do

  • Leave the quiz. Switching tabs, windows or apps counts.
  • Exit full screen or resize the window once you've started.
  • Copy, paste, right-click or take screenshots.
  • Move your mouse off the page for more than a moment.
  • Open developer tools or other ways of peeking at the page.

These are the main ones, not a full list. Each violation costs 1 minute; a second one ends the quiz as a fail.

Official references

Sources by quiz

Each quiz lists the official movie or series it covers. Every question links to the reference pages (Wikipedia and the official Marvel.com page) for its film or episode.

Official channels

Marvel.com Marvel Entertainment · YouTube Marvel Studios · YouTube Disney+ D23 · The Official Disney Fan Club
Quality promise

All questions and answers are checked a minimum of 2 times for understanding, clarity, and logic. Mistakes are uncommon, but not impossible.
